settings.title: Chat title length
settings.summary: The longest title a chat may have.
settings.description: The most characters a chat's title may have.

settings.title: Chat search results
settings.summary: The most results a search of your chats returns.
settings.description: The most results one search over chats returns.

settings.title: Chat search excerpt
settings.summary: About how many words of a match each result shows.
settings.description: About how many words of a matching message a search result shows, from 1 to 64.

settings.title: Messages ranked in a search
settings.summary: The most matching messages one search over chats ranks.
settings.description: The most matching messages one search over chats ranks. When more match, the newest that many are ranked, and a search for any of several words leaves out a word that more messages than this hold while another of its words is in fewer. Zero ranks every match.

settings.title: Chat recaps
settings.summary: Gives each chat a short summary, so past chats are easier to find.
settings.description: Whether each chat is given a recap after its turns: a short summary, its topics and the decisions made in it, which the past-chat search finds chats by. Off, no recap is made after a turn, and the search reads titles and messages alone.

settings.title: Turns between recaps
settings.summary: How many turns pass before a chat's recap is written again.
settings.description: A chat is given its recap once its first turn has ended with a whole reply, and a new one once this many more turns have, from 1 to 1000. The recap is not made again after every turn.

settings.title: Rest before a recap
settings.summary: How long a chat must be quiet before its recap is written.
settings.description: How long a chat must rest after a turn before its recap is made, so it is not made while the person is still writing, from 0s to 24h. 0s makes it as soon as the turn ends.

settings.title: Recap instructions
settings.summary: What the model that writes a recap is told.
settings.default: You write the short summary, topics and decisions of one chat in Keystone, a private workspace for one person, so the chat can be found and understood later. You are given the chat's title, its recap so far if it has one, and its messages, oldest first. Answer with one JSON object and nothing else, in this shape: {"summary": "...", "topics": ["..."], "decisions": ["..."]}. The summary says in at most {words} words what the chat is about, what was found or settled, and where it ended. The topics are at most {topics} short phrases naming what the chat covers. The decisions are at most {decisions} things the person decided, chose or agreed to in the chat, each a short sentence; give an empty list when nothing was decided. Keep what the recap so far says unless a later message changes it. Write about the person and the assistant in plain words.
settings.description: The instruction given to the model that writes a chat's recap. {words}, {topics} and {decisions} become chats.recap_summary_max_words, chats.recap_max_topics and chats.recap_max_decisions.

settings.title: Recap length
settings.summary: The most words a recap's summary may have.
settings.description: The most words a recap's summary may have, from 10 to 1000. A longer one is cut.

settings.title: Recap topics
settings.summary: The most topics a recap keeps.
settings.description: The most topics a recap keeps, from 0 to 50.

settings.title: Recap decisions
settings.summary: The most decisions a recap keeps.
settings.description: The most decisions a recap keeps, from 0 to 50.

settings.title: Recap item length
settings.summary: The longest topic or decision a recap keeps.
settings.description: The longest topic or decision a recap keeps, in characters, from 20 to 2000. A longer one is left out.

settings.title: Message length for recaps
settings.summary: How much of one message the recap model is shown.
settings.description: The most characters of one message the model that writes a recap is shown, from 100 to 100000.

settings.title: Chat length for recaps
settings.summary: How much of a chat the recap model is shown at once.
settings.description: The most characters of a chat the model that writes its recap is shown at once, no less than chats.recap_message_max_chars and at most 1000000. A longer chat is shown its first message and its newest, and the recap so far stands for what came before.

settings.title: Recap output limit
settings.summary: The most the model may write for one recap.
settings.description: The most tokens the model may write for a chat's recap, from 64 to 32000.

settings.title: Recap time limit
settings.summary: How long writing one recap may take.
settings.description: How long making one recap may take before it is given up, from 5s to 30m.

settings.title: Recap retry wait
settings.summary: How long before a failed recap is tried again.
settings.description: How long a chat whose recap failed waits before a turn's end tries again.

settings.title: Past chats found
settings.summary: The most past chats a model's search returns.
settings.description: The most chats one past-chat search by the model (the search_chats tool) returns, from 1 to 50. The model may ask for fewer.

settings.title: Passages from each past chat
settings.summary: How many matching passages of each past chat a model gets.
settings.description: The most matching passages of each chat a past-chat search by the model gives, from 0 to 20.

settings.title: Default model
settings.summary: The model a new chat starts with.
settings.description: The registry name of the model a new chat uses. Empty means the first usable model in the person's registry.

settings.title: Messages waiting
settings.summary: The most messages that may wait behind the one being answered.
settings.description: The most turns that may wait in one chat behind the one that is running.

settings.title: Steps in one turn
settings.summary: The most model calls one reply may take.
settings.description: The most model calls one turn may make, counting each call that follows a tool.

settings.title: Reply length limit
settings.summary: The longest a reply may be; zero is the model's own limit.
settings.description: The most tokens a chat reply may hold. Zero means the model's own limit.

settings.title: Thinking allowance
settings.summary: How much a model may think before it replies; zero is none.
settings.description: The most tokens a model may spend on thinking in a chat turn. Zero asks for no thinking.

settings.title: Stream check
settings.summary: How often an open reply stream looks for new events.
settings.description: How often an open turn stream looks for new events when nothing has woken it.

settings.title: Stream batch size
settings.summary: The most stored events a reply stream reads at a time.
settings.description: The most stored events a turn stream reads from the database at a time.

settings.title: Stop wait
settings.summary: How long Stop waits for a reply to end.
settings.description: How long the stop route waits for a turn to end before it answers.

settings.title: Title chats automatically
settings.summary: Gives each chat a title after its first reply.
settings.description: Whether a chat is given a title after its first reply.

settings.title: Title model
settings.summary: The model that writes chat titles.
settings.description: The registry name of the model that writes chat titles. Empty means the model that answered the chat.

settings.title: Title instructions
settings.summary: What the model that writes a chat's title is told.
settings.default: Write a title of at most six words for the chat that begins below. Answer with the title alone, with no quotation marks and no full stop.
settings.description: The instruction given to the model that writes a chat's title.

settings.title: Title output limit
settings.summary: The most the model may write for a title.
settings.description: The most tokens the model may write for a chat's title.

settings.title: Text shown for a title
settings.summary: How much of the first message and reply the title model sees.
settings.description: How many characters of the first message, and of the first reply, the title model is shown.

settings.title: Title time limit
settings.summary: How long the title model may take.
settings.description: How long the title model may take before the title is made from the first message.

settings.title: Words in a fallback title
settings.summary: How many words of the first message make a title with no model.
settings.description: How many words of the first message make a title when no model writes one.

settings.title: Test model context window
settings.summary: The context window the test person's recorded replies assume.
settings.description: The context window, in tokens, the test tenant's recorded turns are checked against.

settings.title: Test model output limit
settings.summary: The output limit the test person's recorded replies assume.
settings.description: The output limit, in tokens, of the test tenant's recorded turns.

settings.title: Standing instructions
settings.summary: The instructions every chat starts with.
settings.default: You are the assistant in Keystone, a private workspace for one person. Answer plainly, and say so when you do not know something.
settings.description: The standing instructions every chat call starts with. Empty sends none.

settings.title: Context fill
settings.summary: How much of a model's context window one call may fill.
settings.description: The share of a model's input room a chat call may fill, from 1 to 100. The room is the context window less what is kept for the reply.

settings.title: Earlier turns sent
settings.summary: The most earlier turns sent with a message; zero is all that fit.
settings.description: The most earlier turns of a chat one call carries. Zero means as many as fit.

settings.title: Room for attachments
settings.summary: The share of a call that attachments and attached chats may take.
settings.description: The most attachments and attached chats may take of a call, as a percentage of the room left after the rules, the tools and the current message.

settings.title: Room for recalled knowledge
settings.summary: The share of a call that recalled knowledge may take.
settings.description: The most recalled knowledge may take of a call, as a percentage of the room left after the rules, the tools and the current message. That much is held for it ahead of earlier turns.

settings.title: Room for the summary
settings.summary: The share of a call the summary of older turns may take.
settings.description: The most the summary of older history may take of a call, as a percentage of the room left after the rules, the tools and the current message. That much is held for it ahead of earlier turns.

settings.title: Left-out turns note
settings.summary: What the model is told when earlier turns were left out.
settings.default: The earliest part of this chat is not shown to you, because the whole chat no longer fits. If the person refers to something you cannot see, say so and ask.
settings.description: What the model is told when earlier turns of a chat were left out of a call. Empty tells it nothing.

settings.title: Repacking tries
settings.summary: How many times a call that is too large is packed again.
settings.description: How many times a call is packed again, smaller, when the provider counts more tokens in it than Keystone estimated.

settings.title: Summarise long chats
settings.summary: Replaces the oldest turns of a long chat with a summary.
settings.description: Whether the oldest turns of a long chat are summarised, and the summary sent in their place. Off, they are left out with a note, as before.

settings.title: Summarise when this full
settings.summary: How full the room for earlier turns gets before summarising.
settings.description: When the earlier turns of a chat that are not yet summarised take more than this share of the room a call has for them, from 1 to 100, the oldest are summarised. A turn that is left out is summarised whatever the share.

settings.title: Keep after summarising
settings.summary: How much of the earlier turns is left whole after summarising.
settings.description: The oldest turns are summarised until the rest take no more than this share of the room, from 0 to less than chats.compact_trigger_percent. The gap between the two is how far a chat grows between one summary and the next.

settings.title: Summary size
settings.summary: The most room a long chat's summary may take.
settings.description: The most tokens a chat's summary may take, as Keystone estimates them. Its share of a call, chats.context_summary_percent, may make it less.

settings.title: Summary heading
settings.summary: The line a model reads before a long chat's summary.
settings.default: A summary of the earlier part of this chat. The turns it stands for are not shown to you.
settings.description: The line a call is given before the summary of a chat's oldest turns.

settings.title: Summary instructions
settings.summary: What the model that summarises a long chat is told.
settings.default: You keep the running summary of a long chat in Keystone, a private workspace for one person. You are given the summary so far, if there is one, and the turns of the chat that follow it. Write one summary that takes them all in: what the person asked for and why, what was decided, the facts, names and numbers that matter, what they prefer, and what is still open. Keep what the summary so far says unless a later turn changes it. Write plain prose about the person and the assistant, in at most {words} words, and answer with the summary alone.
settings.description: The instruction given to the model that summarises a chat's oldest turns. {words} becomes the most words the summary may have.

settings.title: Message length for summaries
settings.summary: How much of one message the summary model is shown.
settings.description: The most characters of one message the summary model is shown.

settings.title: Summary calls
settings.summary: The most model calls one summary may take.
settings.description: The most model calls one summary of a chat may make, each taking in as many turns as the summary model's window holds.

settings.title: Summary time limit
settings.summary: How long one summary call may take.
settings.description: How long one summary call may take before it is given up, and the oldest turns are left out with the note.

settings.title: Summary retry wait
settings.summary: How long before a failed summary is tried again.
settings.description: How long a chat whose summary failed waits before it is tried again.

settings.title: Attached chats
settings.summary: The most chats you may attach to one chat.
settings.description: The most chats one chat may have attached, the chat it continues from included, from 1 to 50. Each comes into every call of the chat as its summary.

settings.title: Messages in an attached page
settings.summary: How many messages a model reads from an attached chat at a time.
settings.description: The most messages one page of an attached chat holds when the model opens it with open_attached_chat, from 1 to 500.

settings.title: Attached page length
settings.summary: How much text a model reads from an attached chat at a time.
settings.description: The most characters one page of an attached chat holds when the model opens it, from 500 to 200000. A message longer than that is cut short.

settings.title: Wait for an attached summary
settings.summary: How long a reply waits for an attached chat's summary.
settings.description: How long the first call of a turn waits for an attached chat's summary to be made, when it has none or its chat has moved on since, from 1s to 10m. A summary not made in time is left for the next turn, and the chat is carried as it is.

settings.title: Import gap between chats
settings.summary: How long a pause in New Keystone starts a new imported chat.
settings.description: New Keystone kept one continuing chat and no separate chats. The import from it (tools/tenant import) starts a new chat wherever more than this long passed between one turn and the next, from 1m to 720h. Shorter makes more and smaller chats, each about one thing; the dry run says how many there would be.

settings.title: Imported title length
settings.summary: The longest title an imported chat is given.
settings.description: An imported chat is titled by the first words of its first message. This is the most characters of them the title takes, cut at a word's end, from 10 to 150.

settings.title: Import time zone
settings.summary: The time zone New Keystone kept its routines' times in.
settings.description: The time zone New Keystone kept its routines' times in, an IANA name. The import dates a routine run's chat in it, and gives it to a person who has no agents.time_zone of their own, so a routine at 07:00 there is a schedule at 07:00 here.

settings.title: Hold imported chats
settings.summary: Which imported chats are kept to local or trusted models.
settings.description: Which imported chats are held to local or trusted models, as a chat that was sent content from a sensitive space is. New Keystone marked nothing as sensitive, so none are by default. wiki holds the chats in which New Keystone read the person's Waymarks wiki; all holds every imported chat. A held chat stays held, and is left out of the past-chat search for a hosted model.

settings.title: Chats in one page of the table
settings.summary: How many chats one page of the Chats table holds.
settings.description: How many chats one page of the Chats screen's table holds, from 1 to 500. The screen reads the next page as the end of the list comes into view.

settings.title: Most chats selected at once
settings.summary: The most chats that selecting every match picks at once.
settings.description: The most chats "select all that match" selects at once on the Chats screen, from 1 to 100000. With more than this the screen says how many it took, and the rest are selected after those are dealt with.

settings.title: Chats deleted in one request
settings.summary: The most chats one delete request removes.
settings.description: The most chats one delete request removes, from 1 to 1000. The Chats screen sends a larger selection as several requests, one after another.

settings.title: Pinned message heading
settings.summary: The line a model reads before a pinned message.
settings.default: A message from earlier in this chat that the person pinned, so it is always shown to you.
settings.description: The line a call is given before a pinned message whose turn is not sent.
